categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/ wallet loading, DB error handling, and carries the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Failing wallet loading on corrupt transaction records stops the wallet from operating with partially loaded transactions and triggering repeated full chain rescans. When a transaction record's stored key does not match its deserialized hash, the wallet previously inserted it into `mapWallet` without spend or conflict tracking or TXO caching while looping through a rescan from genesis on every restart.
